::: {.callout-note}
## This Tutorial Has Moved

This tutorial has been replaced by two updated pages:

- [Bayesian Parameter Inference with NumPyro](../basics/bayesian_inference.qmd)
  introduces forward simulation, NUTS, SVI, parameter uncertainty, and predictions.
- [Bayesian Stimulation Inference: Identifiability and Prior Sensitivity](Stimulation_Prior_Sensitivity.qmd)
  develops the stimulation case study with matched observation noise, Fisher
  geometry, prior sensitivity, MAP estimates, and predictive checks.

Each replacement provides its own downloadable notebook and Colab link.

:::
